creator: Alexander Terp
description: A pane sets TERMINFO_DIRS to the daemon's data dir so TERM=xterm-ghostty resolves. sudo's env_reset drops TERMINFO_DIRS, and Ghostty's own sudo shell-integration feature (which carries TERMINFO through sudo) stays off. So on a host whose ncurses lacks xterm-ghostty (Debian bookworm, ncurses 6.4), sudo vim in a devenv pane cannot find the terminal. Options: a sudo feature that passes the terminfo through, installing the entry to ~/.terminfo on remote install, or accepting it. Related: a_2XQEFtV0H (ssh from a pane).
title: sudo in a pane on a host without the xterm-ghostty terminfo
